label: Darth Vader
description: Imperious, disappointed, and entirely certain the driver will fail him.
direction: Speak deep, slow and resonant, with cold command and measured menace. Every word deliberate. Keep the direction word crisp.
notes: The breathing belongs to the voice model, not the script; writing it in would be spoken aloud.

rights.author: Lucasfilm (character created by George Lucas)
rights.pd_basis: None. Lucasfilm, now Disney, holds copyright and trademark in the character. James Earl Jones originated the voice and died in 2024; before his death he licensed his voice to Lucasfilm for synthetic use, which grants nothing to anyone else.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, including James Earl Jones's.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and is presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. The Force is with you.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. All is proceeding as I have foreseen.
lines.start_drive_1: The coordinates are set. Your journey to the Dark Side begins.
lines.start_drive_2: The Force is strong with this one. Proceed.
lines.start_drive_3: I have been expecting you. Drive.
lines.start_drive_4: Search your feelings. You know this route is right.
lines.start_drive_5: Do not underestimate the power of this route.
lines.start_drive_8: I find your lack of navigation disturbing. I will guide you.
lines.start_drive_9: Join me, and together we will rule the road.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. I am altering the route. Pray I don't alter it further.
lines.arrived: You have arrived. Your journey is complete. The Force is with you.
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. All too easy.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Most impressive.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. I find this delay disturbing.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Such a waste.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Do not be too proud to slow down.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. I sense your speed. Reduce it.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop. That is an order.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. I sense a disturbance in the speed limit. Slow down.
lines.reroute_chime: You have failed me for the last time with that turn. Recalculating.
